messages:
ada: noticing oscillation in dedicated pools when multiple tenants hit burst lanes simultaneously. autoscaler ramps up, then drains hard when credits exhausted, causing latency spikes. thinking tokenized burst lanes + hysteresis might help. thoughts?

kyle: agree. observed same in load test v3. bursts pile on one shard, then other shards overreact. tokenized lanes would give bounded burst per-tenant per-shard.

javier: can you sketch the token semantics? global tokens vs local tokens? how to avoid cross-shard starvation?

ada: sketch: two-tier tokens: global tenant budget + local shard bucket. admit requires H(consumed + requested <= min(global_budget, local_bucket)). tokens top-up periodically. on shortage, admission tries borrow from sibling shards if underutilized. borrow window has strict cap.

meera: borrowing needs atomicity otherwise double-admit. propose optimistic borrow with compare-and-swap on ledger entry, fallback to local deny. also track `borrow_failures` metric.

kyle: admission pseudocode: 
```
// attempt fast local admit
if local_tokens >= req: consume local_tokens
else if cache.global_tokens >= req and try_cas(global, delta): consume global
else deny
```
fastpath avoids RPC except CAS on miss.

rachel: what about autoscaler hysteresis? we should decouple scaling triggers from momentary borrow activity. suggest scale-up if sustained queue > q_threshold for scale_window (30s), scale-down only if queue < q_threshold/2 for cooldown (2m).

javier: +1. also add 'soft-drain' flag when we expect shrink: stop admitting optimistic loans and honor only ledger reservations for N seconds prior to remove nodes. reduces dropped work during node termination.

meera: metrics to add: `burst.tokens_local`, `burst.tokens_global`, `burst.borrow_rate`, `autoscaler.scale_events`, `autoscaler.cooldown_active`. alerts: borrow_rate spike > X or scale_down during high_borrow => paging.

ada: rollout plan: 1) implement local token fastpath only (no borrow), expose metrics. 2) enable global ledger CAS borrow with feature flag. 3) add autoscaler hysteresis tuning and soft-drain. each step rollout Canary->Staging->Prod.

kyle: fallback behavior? if ledger unavailable, fastpath should still use local_tokens for non-SLA tenants, SLA tenants get errors. config: `burst.admit.fallback: local|fail`

rachel: operator changes: need CRD fields for `burstPolicy`, `borrowCap`, `softDrainSeconds`. I can add to helm chart + upgrade job to set defaults.

javier: perf note: CAS on global ledger could be hot; add a sharded keyspace per-tenant with mod(hash(shard)). reduces contention. also bulk-replenish RPCs to minimize calls.

meera: add reconciler job that rebalances leftover local_tokens into global ledger during checkpoint intervals. emits `burst.rebalanced` metric.

ops-bot: infra action: schedule canary deploy of `burst-controller` v0.2.0 to staging 2024-11-02T02:00Z by rachel.

ada: security note: borrowing cross-tenant forbidden. borrow only within same tenant across shards. also audit log every borrow with request_id and caller.

kyle: op-level knobs: `burst.optimistic_limit_pct` (default 5%), `burst.borrow_window_ms` (default 200), `autoscaler.scale_window_ms`, `autoscaler.cooldown_ms`.

rachel: I'll own operator PR + helm changes. kyle + javier own runtime admits, meera owns metrics/dashboards, ada will write a follow-up RFC summarizing decisions.

ada: ok let's run synthetic with 1000 tenants, short spikes and long tails. sam (perf) if you can sign-off next week that'd be great. :thumbsup:
